summary: Retest of Inside Sri Lanka group-tour fixes (clock 2026-10-26). Backend: new test_group_seats_fullpay.py (5 tests) plus regression test_group_bookings.py (15 tests): 20/20 pass. Departures under 60 days (11-14, 11-28, 12-12) return full_payment true, deposit_pct 100 and balance_due null. Later departures have 10% (5% early-bird from 13 Feb) with balance_due = start - 60 days. A paid order on 2027-01-09 for 2 people cut seats_left from 6 to 4 and changed the status to limited; an unpaid order did not change seats. Ordering 5 then returned 400 ('Only 4 seats left'). Frontend desktop 1440: centring days 3/8/11/1/5 sets the matching active day. Yala pin is active and the caption reads 'Day 8 · Yala'. Nuwara Eliya and Ella labels do not overlap. No fetchpriority or other console errors. Mobile 390: centring days 2/6/10 sets the matching active day, and the compact map shows 8 pins with only the active label. Dates rows, modal (Nov 14 full-payment box, no balance line, 'Reserve · pay ₹4,00,000'; Jan 9 '10% deposit today ₹43,000', balance ₹3,87,000, 'Reserve with ₹43,000 deposit') and checkout (pax clamped to 4 with notice and ₹8,00,000 total; Jan 9 ₹43,000 deposit with balance; Nov 14 'pay in full', 'Pay ₹2,00,000 full payment') all checked. The desktop E2E for 2027-01-23 (pax 2, twin) went modal -> checkout -> mock ₹43,000 -> confirmed page with Deposit paid ₹43,000, Balance due by 24 Nov 2026, Trip total ₹4,30,000. The API then returned seats_left 0 / sold_out and the detail row showed Sold out with a disabled button. The TEST_ booking was deleted and seats went back to 2.

minor.issue: Seats are only checked when the order is created, not when payment is verified. Two pending orders for the last seats can both be paid, which oversells the departure. seats_left is then clamped to 0, which hides the oversell.
The booking doc always stores payment:'deposit' and Razorpay notes payment:'deposit', even for full-payment departures. It should be 'full' when dep.full_payment is true.

design_issues.screen: Detail page sidebar card + mobile sticky bar
issues: Both still say 'Pay only ₹20,000 deposit today (10%)' (mobile: 'Pay only ₹20,000 deposit'), but the next 3 departures need full payment. The headline should use the next open departure, or say 'from ₹20,000 deposit on departures 60+ days out'.
Step 2 of the stepper still says 'Pay deposit' on full-payment departures
In the summary box, 'Full payment due now' and '₹8,00,000' have almost no gap between them
Copy 'secure your seat with a small deposit' does not mention that departures under 60 days are paid in full (minor)

action_items: Optional: re-check seats_left in verify for group bookings (or reserve seats atomically) to stop overselling
Store payment:'full' on group bookings when dep.full_payment is true
Make the sidebar and mobile-bar 'Pay only ₹20,000 deposit' copy match the full payment needed on the nearest departures
Change checkout step 2 to 'Pay in full' for full-payment departures and add a gap between the label and amount in the summary box
critical_code_review_comments: group_bookings.py: verify does not re-check seats, so concurrent paid orders can oversell; live_departures' max(0, ...) hides it

test_group_bookings.py::test_verify_and_get created PAID TEST_ bookings with no cleanup. Since seats are now cut by paid bookings, each run took 2 seats off 2027-02-13 (it had dropped from 10 to 4). I added a module teardown fixture that deletes TEST_group* bookings
Under xdist, the module teardown can run in one worker while the other is still running tests. Low flakiness risk; passed 2 times
seed_data_creation: None left behind. All TEST_ group bookings were deleted from db.bookings, and 2027-02-13 is back to 10 seats.
